{"data":{"help":{"id":"5RxOgRrAsImHenVGoTCeuX","identifier":"what-is-an-installation","title":"What is an installation?","body":"

Installations are servers that make datasets available on the internet. Some publishers run their own technical installations, e.g., using the IPT, through which data is shared with GBIF. Some installations are collaborations and may be shared by multiple publishers.
